artworks.title: Près Houlgate (Calvados)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Japan paper
artworks.description: The image displays a shore with towering cliffs to the right, as the sea meets the sky on the left. A precise linework style is used, with detailed strokes creating textures and contours on the cliffs and rocks. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and gray for a dramatic contrast. Delicate, linear wispy clouds are visible in the sky. The rocks appear less distinct as they recede into the distance.

artworks.title: Kleine Dada Soirée (Small Dada Evening)
artworks.artist: Theo van Doesburg and Kurt Schwitters
artworks.medium: lithographic poster/program, printed in red and black on wove paper
artworks.description: This print displays a complex arrangement of letters and words overlapping with one another. The page is covered with lines of black text in different fonts and sizes, different chunks facing different directions. There are also small black illustrations, such as pointing hands, arrows, and a small deer. Overlapping with these black words and images, the word "DADA" has been printed in thick letters with bright red ink several times on the off-white page.”

artworks.title: A Woman Walking along a Country Road (La Femme sur la Route)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with drypoint on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 15.4 x 20.6 cm (6 1/16 x 8 1/8 in.) (irregular)
sheet: 24 x 26.4 cm (9 7/16 x 10 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a slightly elevated point of view. There is a path or road with a solitary figure walking away from the viewer. Beyond the figure, there are fields and a vast expanse of land leading to the horizon. The horizon is high, indicating a broad view. The sky above has swirling, textured clouds. The brushstrokes are stippled and varied, creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black, white, and gray.

artworks.title: The Ashes of Trajan Carried in a Triumphal Procession
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ancient Roman triumphal procession. It features a grand parade through imposing classical architecture with intricate columns and friezes. The scene showcases a multitude of figures engaged in various activities, including individuals carrying banners and items, and some riding in elaborate chariots. Monumental buildings reminiscent of Roman architecture are seen in the background. The atmosphere is bustling and energetic, and the bottom section of the drawing contains additional narrative friezes.

artworks.title: The Body of Hadrian Laying in State next to His Mausoleum
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand architectural scene with a triumphal procession. The image features a large, domed structure reminiscent of ancient Roman architecture, suggesting a temple or forum. In the foreground, there is a procession of figures in robes, some with raised arms holding torches. To the right, there are figures on horseback, and the assembly seems to be part of a grand ceremonial event. Above the figures, a monumental structure topped with a quadriga looms, adorned with intricate sculptures and reliefs. The drawing style captures fine details of the architecture and the motion of the crowd, providing a sense of historical grandeur and festive atmosphere.

artworks.title: Le Réveil de Venus (Venus Awakening)
artworks.medium: pastel manner printed in black, red, blue, white, and yellow-brown on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman reclining on a bed. She is partially covered with a light draped fabric, has a serene expression, and bright eyes. Her hair is styled with waves and a braided arrangement with flowers. She wears a headband of flowers and a garland around her hips. She holds a floral garland and a dove is perched on her thigh. The bedding beneath her is plush and the background features flowing fabric in shades of blue and gray.

artworks.title: Groenendael Abbey
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: The Ellen von Seggern Richter and Jan Paul Richter Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a historical architectural complex surrounded by water. The buildings have gabled roofs and a central spire. Tall trees stand to the left of the buildings. The water reflects the buildings and the sky. The style of the image is detailed and precise, resembling an engraving with delicate line work. The color palette is monochrome with shades of brown and grey. In the distance, there is sky with a few clouds.

artworks.title: An Abbey by a Wooded Lake at Twilight
artworks.medium: pastel on blue wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helen Porter and James T. Dyke Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a serene body of water with an urban landscape in the distance. The skyline features tall, slender silhouettes of structures, and the horizon is not clearly visible. The brushstrokes are soft and blend smoothly. The color palette includes deep blues, rusts, browns, and pastel tones of blue and peach. Darkened trees frame the scene, highlighting the contrast between shadowed areas and distant structures.

artworks.title: Brutus Condemning His Sons to Death
artworks.medium: black chalk and white chalk with stumping
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a dynamic scene. The drawing showcases several sketches of people intermingled in what appears to be an animated gathering or event within a room. The central figure seems to be reclined or in a seated position, surrounded by other figures who appear to be engaged in expressive postures. The artist uses fluid, sweeping lines and shading to suggest movement and depth, capturing a sense of drama and motion in the composition. There is a play of light and shadow, enhancing the three-dimensionality of the scene. The overall atmosphere implies a historical or mythological setting, as suggested by the attire and architectural elements in the background.

artworks.title: "Wooding Up" on the Mississippi
artworks.medium: color lithograph with hand-coloring on wove paper
artworks.description: This print shows a nighttime scene on a large river. In the center is a steamboat named "PRINCESS" that is being loaded with wood by several people gathered around a fire. Smokestacks on the ship emit orange smoke into the dark sky. In the distance on the left, another steamboat is visible under a full moon, and clouds drift across the night sky. A bright moon lines the edges of the clouds in white. The color scheme includes deep blues and blacks with bright whites and warm oranges from the steamboat's lights and smoke. There is a line of text below the print.

artworks.title: The Rialto Bridge, Venice
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite and scratching out on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone in honor of James and Elizabeth Mackinnon
artworks.description: The image shows a canal scene from an elevated angle with buildings and the sky lining the horizon. An arched stone bridge is at the center, with detailed architecture. The brushstrokes are refined, depicting the structure and water ripples. The color palette consists of blues and earthy tones capturing light and shadow. Buildings on each side of the canal are illuminated by sunlight. Small boats float on the water, some with sailcloths open. Human figures are visible near the water and further down the canal.

artworks.title: The Fall of Man (Der Sündenfall)
artworks.medium: color woodcut with unique inking on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features abstract sweeping and jagged lines that form indistinct shapes. Amidst the brushstrokes, the shapes vaguely resemble human-like forms interacting. Their elongated limbs and postures suggest movement. The swirling lines add texture, reminiscent of flowing fabrics or organic forms.

artworks.title: Statue of Clovis, Church of Sainte-Clotilde, Paris
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a regal figure wearing a crown and a robe or tunic that drapes over the shoulders and down to the feet. The figure holds a staff or scepter in the left hand while the right hand rests on the chest. The sculpture is set in a niche with elaborate gothic architectural details above it, including pointed arches and spires. The material of the sculpture is a light stone, giving it a uniform earthy tone that complements the architectural setting. The figure stands elevated on a small pedestal.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis im Strohhut, als Brustbild (Self-Portrait in a Straw Hat, Bust Length)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on J. W. Zanders wove paper
artworks.description: This is an ink drawing of a man shown from the chest up, sitting at an angle with his body facing slightly to the side while his face turns towards the viewer. He has a prominent mustache and eyebrows, and is wearing a coat with a large collar and a hat with a distinct band. The background is plain and unadorned. A signature is visible at the bottom of the artwork.

artworks.title: Young Woman Sewing with a Dog Resting on Her Lap
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows a seated woman with a full body view. She sits on a chair holding an object in her hands, potentially sewing or knitting. Her posture is slightly slouched, head tilted forward, looking down at her hands. Facial features include a gentle brow, closed lips, and partially visible eyes due to the downward gaze. She wears a bonnet, a long dress, and has a small dog draped on her lap. The background is plain with no distinct features.

artworks.title: A Soldier Walking with a Camp Follower
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two full figures of individuals, a man and a woman, standing together. The man is on the left, in a slightly angled stance with his head turned toward the woman. He has curly hair and is wearing an elaborate outfit with puffed sleeves and decorative elements, including a large feathered adornment on his back. The woman stands on the right, facing the man, and is positioned slightly behind him. Her hair is styled in an elaborate manner with curls and adorned with a headpiece. She is wearing a dress with accentuated shoulders and a tight bodice, detailed with accents and a belt, and extends her arm. Both figures stand on a ground with rocks and foliage, and in the background, there is a landscape featuring a river, trees, and buildings with prominent towers.

artworks.title: Travelers in Gigantic Caverns
artworks.artist: Johann Peter Pichler, after Guillam Dubois
artworks.medium: mezzotint on wove paper, proof before caption
artworks.description: The image shows an interior view of a cavernous space with towering rock formations arching overhead in a series of vaults. The perspective leads towards the depths of the cavern where the rock formations extend. There is no visible horizon as the scene is dominated by the intricate cave ceiling and the interplay of light and shadow. A group of figures in historical attire are near a rocky outcrop, giving a sense of human scale against the natural architecture. The brushstrokes are detailed, emphasizing the texture of the rock surfaces and vegetation. The color palette is subdued, with shades of brown and grey enhancing the dramatic atmosphere. Light filters through openings, casting a soft glow that contrasts with the shadows, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Travelers Resting in Gigantic Caverns
artworks.artist: Johann Peter Pichler, after Guillam Dubois
artworks.medium: mezzotint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a cave scene with towering rock formations and figures navigating the landscape. The horizon is obscured by the cave ceiling. The composition leads the eye deeper into the cavern with high, arching rock structures. Detailed lines and shading create texture and scale, with varied tones for depth and shadow. The color palette is muted with grays and browns. Figures and pack animals traverse rugged terrain, providing scale to the cave environment. In the distance, archways, pillars, and a play of light and shadow are visible.

artworks.title: Ihr Menschen Vereinigt Euch
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on wove buff paper
artworks.description: The image features bold, dark lines and curved shapes forming an abstract composition on a light background. The abstract arrangement resembles a human figure reaching upwards with text surrounding it. The flowing lines and dynamic shapes suggest familiar objects like a person in motion, while the text adds an element of mystery and complexity to the artwork.

artworks.title: Mars and Venus Adulterous
artworks.artist: Hans Collaert the Younger, after Philip Galle
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in an embrace. One figure sits on a bed while the other leans into them, their arms entwined. Both individuals have Roman features with defined profiles, draped in cloth revealing their upper bodies. The setting includes bed curtains, bedding, a shield, a helmet, and a cherub-like figure in the background. The backdrop features architectural and decorative details with flower motifs.

artworks.title: Vulcan Hanging an Iron Net above the Bed
artworks.artist: Hans Collaert the Younger, after Philip Galle
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.2 × 22.7 cm (7 3/16 × 8 15/16 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two muscular figures pulling a large net or cloth in a classical architectural setting. The scene is set within an oval frame with decorative elements around it. The two figures are standing on a checkered floor, and their bodies are shown in dynamic poses, exerting force as they pull the net or cloth towards each other. There is a small cherub-like figure sitting on the floor between them, holding its head on one hand and looking contemplative. Classical columns and distant landscapes are visible in the background, suggesting an expansive space beyond the immediate scene. Ornamental details in the border emphasize the classical theme, with intricate designs enhancing the overall composition.

artworks.title: Phoebus Telling Vulcan of His Wife's Adultery
artworks.artist: Hans Collaert the Younger, after Philip Galle
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18.5 × 22.3 cm (7 5/16 × 8 3/4 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a mythological scene. Two figures are in the foreground, one seated on a large square stone holding a tool, while the other stands beside them with a bow, gesturing. In the background, laborers work at anvils in a cavernous space resembling a forge. The composition includes leaf motifs at the corners. The background shows a coastal landscape with cliffs, trees, water, and sailing vessels. The figures are idealized, with emphasis on their physiques, hinting at a classical mythological or epic narrative.

artworks.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes
artworks.artist: Christoffel van Sichem I, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing depicts two figures, one holding a sword and the other holding a severed head. In the background, there is a tent and a desolate landscape with a crescent moon and softly etched mountains or hills. The figures are dressed in elaborately detailed garments, suggestive of a historical or ancient setting. The line work is intricate and meticulous, allowing for rich textures in the clothing and background elements. The drawing style is typical of detailed woodcut or printmaking techniques, creating a sense of depth and dramatic narrative within the composition.

artworks.title: Mars and Venus Surprised by Vulcan
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
